title: Combination of Diosmetin With Chrysin Against Hepatocellular Carcinoma Through Inhibiting PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-small ka, CyrillicB Signaling Pathway: TCGA Analysis, Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics, In Vitro Experiment.
authors: Yu, Xiang; Zhang, Di; Hu, Chengming; Yu, Zejun; Li, Yang; Fang, Cheng; Qiu, Yinsheng; Mei, Zhinan; Xu, Lingyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物联合抑制肝癌PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-κB通路，分子对接与动力学对象为信号蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the sixth most prevalent malignant tumor. Hepatocellular carcinogenesis is closely linked to apoptosis, autophagy, and inflammation. Diosmetin and chrysin, are two flavonoid compounds, exhibit anti-inflammatory and anticancer properties. In this study, the TCGA database was utilized to identify differentially expressed genes between normal subjects and HCC patients. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics analyses were employed to assess the binding affinity of chrysin and diosmetin to key proteins in the PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Western blotting and RT-qPCR were used to measure the protein and gene expression within this pathway. The results indicated that HCC patients had elevated levels of PI3K, AKT, mTOR, and P65 proteins compared to normal subjects, which adversely affected patient survival. Molecular docking and dynamics studies demonstrated that diosmetin and chrysin are effectively bound to these four proteins. In vitro experiments revealed that the combination of diosmetin and chrysin could induce apoptosis, enhance autophagy, reduce inflammatory mediator production, and improve the tumor cell microenvironment by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Notably, the synergy score for the combination of diosmetin (25 muM) and chrysin (10 muM) was 16. Thus, the diosmetin-chrysin combination shows promise as an effective therapeutic approach for hepatocellular carcinoma due to its strong synergistic effect.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是第六大常见恶性肿瘤。肝细胞癌的发生与细胞凋亡、自噬和炎症密切相关。地奥司明（diosmetin）和白杨素（chrysin）是两种黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎和抗癌特性。本研究利用TCGA数据库识别正常受试者与HCC患者之间的差异表达基因。采用分子对接和分子动力学分析评估白杨素和地奥司明与PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-kappaB信号通路中关键蛋白的结合亲和力。使用Western blotting和RT-qPCR测量该通路中的蛋白和基因表达。结果表明，与正常受试者相比，HCC患者的PI3K、AKT、mTOR和P65蛋白水平升高，这对患者生存产生不利影响。分子对接和动力学研究表明，地奥司明和白杨素能有效结合这四种蛋白。体外实验揭示，地奥司明和白杨素的联合使用可通过抑制PI3K/AKT/mTOR/NF-kappaB信号通路诱导细胞凋亡、增强自噬、减少炎症介质产生，并改善肿瘤细胞微环境。值得注意的是，地奥司明（25 μM）和白杨素（10 μM）联合使用的协同评分为16。因此，地奥司明-白杨素联合因其强协同效应，有望成为肝细胞癌的有效治疗策略。
